query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace
MATCH p = (n :Namespace)-[:EndpointsWithSelector]->(s)<-[e *1..3]-()
WHERE type(e) IN ['Ingress', 'IngressDeny', 'FromNamespace']
AND n.displayname = namespace
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Ingress (EndpointSelector)
description: Ingress from endpoint selectors for a specific namespace
